_comment: Synthetic CONFORMING egress picture for the ISSUED{service_id} wrong-destination egress block (doc 16 §5.1/§6/§10; doc 06 §3c inject-class twin, digest half). The check must pass clean (zero violations); the green control proves BOTH the wrong-destination block AND the matching-destination pass in one picture.
